cue: An outward action is taken on an older instruction while a newer one waits unread.
lesson: Read every pending notification right before an outward action (a pull request, a push to a shared branch, a deploy, a settings change), not only at the start of the turn.
evidence: aip-59ad: avenMAIA's 14:08Z message said not to open a pull request for checkpoint 2; it was read only after #1783 was opened on the 13:57Z instruction. The deploy shipped off, so nothing went live; avenMAIA kept #1783.
